learner_operation: Use the augmented entries to normalize the first pivot, eliminate the lower-left entry, normalize the second pivot, and select the resulting REF; optionally back-substitute for x,y.

fixed_features.feature: Nonsingular 2x3 augmented matrix; nonzero initial pivot; normalized forward REF; five radio choices.
fixed_features.justification: Canonical 0a9e6824 and tutorial 2112d3af specify these row operations and complete source banks use five radio choices; no row exchange is taught here.

fixed_features.feature: Ten observed coefficient profiles with bounded RHS scales and five candidate lower-right values.
fixed_features.justification: Finite conservative practice retains source coefficient/denominator workload. Source does not require fixed answer rank or position; each candidate can qualify. Bounds limit transfer claims rather than imply arbitrary matrix mastery.

fixed_features.feature: A five-item batch initially shares coefficient block, upper input row and answer bank.
fixed_features.justification: Controlled contrast holds incidental features fixed while the decisive lower RHS changes. All five candidate decisions occur once and all positions occur once, requiring reconsideration of lower RHS. Source Gaussian-elimination dependency is preserved; repeated bank alone is not sufficient evidence of an incidental predictor. Identical stored answer order does not imply identical rendered order; the UI reorders by item and field identity.
